At runtime, use the SystemExtensions framework to install or update the extension on the user’s system.
To successfully activate your extension, you must adhere to the following rules: The extension must match your bundle identifier, excluding file extension.

You must use the same Team ID when signing the extension that you use for signing your app, unless the extension has the entitlement.
You must either distribute your app and extension through the Mac App Store, or notarize them.
